description: Close every EMPTY token account of this agent's own app wallet (owner = the local P-256 key from create_app_wallet) and send the rent to the sign-in wallet (default) or back to the app wallet. A non-empty account is never included. The transaction is decoded and checked locally (only CloseAccount, authority = the app wallet, rent to the chosen destination) before the owner key signs. Moves only rent.

destination.description: where the rent goes; default app_wallet (then app_wallet_withdraw moves the SOL to your sign-in wallet)

name: close_empty_accounts
title: Close empty token accounts (agent-owned app wallet)
